notes: Stories validated; no duplicates; full coverage across schema, logic, interface, tests, and audit.

MAINT-BRAIN-S1.title: Define GPTReader Manifest-Aware Schema and Contract
MAINT-BRAIN-S1.description: Define a strict request/response contract for GPTReader that includes manifest references, query constraints (doc limit, size cap), and audit metadata fields to ensure consistent and validated data access patterns.

MAINT-BRAIN-S2.title: Implement GPTReader Reliability and Guardrail Logic
MAINT-BRAIN-S2.description: Enhance GPTReader core logic to enforce limits (100-doc, 500KB), implement retry/backoff for transient failures, ensure deterministic truncation behavior, and perform runtime validation against the active manifest snapshot before query execution.

MAINT-BRAIN-S3.title: Expose Manifest-Aligned GPTReader Access Interface
MAINT-BRAIN-S3.description: Standardize GPTReader invocation across Brain runner, SIT, and QA by enforcing manifest-backed queries, validating against manifest_generator outputs, ensuring structured responses, and aligning with prompt_system_maker tool contracts.

MAINT-BRAIN-S4.title: Build GPTReader Unit and Integration Test Suite
MAINT-BRAIN-S4.description: Expand unit and integration tests to validate schema compliance, limit enforcement, truncation determinism, manifest alignment (including manifest drift scenarios), error handling, and SIT scenario compatibility.

MAINT-BRAIN-S5.title: Standardize Audit Logging and Traceability for GPTReader
MAINT-BRAIN-S5.description: Implement consistent audit logging across GPTReader including request metadata, manifest snapshot/version references, response size, truncation events, error states, and correlation IDs aligned with Brain audit expectations.
